auth.description: A new public GET-only metadata route is explicitly added before authMiddleware; it is read-only and guarded by query validation, projection, per-IP best-effort throttle and caching. Existing authenticated connections/actions/OAuth remain unchanged.

tenant.description: Anonymous public catalog has no tenant context by design and never returns user-scoped content. The canonical service's public metadata mode is used, with custom/deprecated filtering. Tenant-bearing integration endpoints remain authenticated and unchanged.

approval.description: No new external tool actions or approvals; only discoverability and navigation.

credentials.description: No tokens are accepted, stored, revealed or sent by the public page.

egress.description: Public request may cause bounded, cached provider metadata GET requests to Composio using the existing platform API key held server-side; the provider key is never sent to browsers. Provider logos remain HTTPS browser assets, referrer suppressed; usage and republishing permissions require production review.

cost.description: Anonymous public metadata GET may use metered Composio API requests. 5-minute upstream metadata cache, CDN cache and in-process rate limit are used; production still requires verified rate/credit budgets and edge abuse protection.

billing.description: Links to existing free signup; no billing changes.
